messages:
Aisha K.: quick q — are we switching default /v1/generate to include choices[*].metadata next week? wondering about unpinned clients.

Samir Patel: yes that's the plan from infra sync. unpinned requests will get the new metadata block. pinned requests (with model_version) should continue to see the old shape.

Matt P.: need to be careful. last change added an extra header and broke some older SDK parsers.

Samir Patel: agreed. runtime precedence: Accept-Schema header -> explicit model_version (body or X-Model-Version header) -> default routing. If model_version present we route to pinned binary and do not add any extra headers.

Liz Chen: SDKs are tolerant, but some users index into choices by position. metadata inside choices is additive so parsers shouldn't break. still, we'll add test vectors.

Aisha K.: can we support an opt-in header for canaries? e.g.:

```
Accept-Schema: application/vnd.redwood.v2+json
```

Samir Patel: yep. runtime will honor that header and prefer it over default routing. doc the order.

Henrietta (PM): proposed timeline: announce today; SDK patches in 7 days; opt-in header live now; staged rollout for unpinned hosted traffic at 30 days; full flip at 60 days. rollback: immediate revert to schema_v1 if errors.

Matt P.: add changelog + migration guide with py/js snippets. also add CLI snippet to probe schema via HEAD/OPTIONS.

Liz Chen: CI: add golden fixtures choices_v1.json and choices_v2.json and parser tests against both. will add a gating job.

Aisha K.: who owns docs PR?

Henrietta (PM): Aisha takes docs PR and migration guide; Liz add diffs to T-2348; Samir add runtime flag + ops play; Matt review SDKs.

Samir Patel: ops play: feature-flag `schema_v2` toggled per-region via feature-store; rollout stages: staging -> 5% -> 25% -> 100%. fallback: route unpinned to schema_v1 binary until flag cleared.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: feature-flag/schema_v2 toggle -> staging -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% (ETA: 48h)

Aisha K.: summary checklist:
- runtime: header precedence + feature-flag (Samir)
- tests: golden fixtures + parser tests (Liz)
- SDKs: non-breaking patch + migration examples (Matt)
- docs: migration guide + changelog (Aisha)
- comms: 60-day notice email + changelog (Henrietta)

Samir Patel: opening runtime PR and will link here.

Matt P.: ping me for SDK review.

Liz Chen: adding fixtures and CI job.

Aisha K.: tagging followups: @Samir Patel @Liz Chen @Matt P. — will update T-2348 by EOD.
